newsitem.title: USA: Lindberg adopts stockholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Lindberg adopts stockholder rights plan.

text.p: Lindberg Corp said Friday its board adopted a stockholder rights plan, declaring a dividend distribution of one common share purchase right on each outstanding share of common stock of the company.
Lindberg said the rights are designed to assure all shareholders receive fair and equal treatment in the event of any proposed takeover. The company said it is unaware of any takeover proposals.

Each right will entitle holders to buy one share of common stock of Lindberg at an initial exercise price of $40 per share. The rights would become exercisable if a person or group acquired 20 percent or more of the common stock.
The dividend distribution will be payable to holders of record on December 13, 1996. The rights will expire on November 21, 2006.
Lindberg provides commercial heat treating to the metalworking industries.
